Title: Define churn target, eligibility, dates and modelling rules
Description: Confirm the churn/retention definition, eligible population, exclusions, as-of date, feature window, outcome window and modelling rules.

Title: Identify required source data and prepare joins
Description: Confirm the required Databricks tables/views and fields, then prepare the source joins and transformation logic.

Title: Build and validate account-level modelling dataset
Description: Create one row per account_id per as_of_date and validate uniqueness, record counts and population coverage.

Title: Develop account, tenure and product features
Description: Create approved account-level tenure, lifecycle, product and related customer/account features.

Title: Develop behavioural, transaction, rollover and engagement features
Description: Create approved behavioural, contribution, transaction, rollover, withdrawal, engagement and trend features.

Title: Implement categorical and missing-value treatment
Description: Apply consistent categorical encoding/grouping and deterministic missing-value treatment for modelling.

Title: Validate feature quality, duplicates and leakage
Description: Validate feature completeness, ranges, duplicates, account-level grain and target leakage.

Title: Select final ML feature set
Description: Identify constant/low-value fields and select the final modelling features based on quality and suitability.

Title: Review and sign off features with Business SME
Description: Review selected features and business interpretation with the SME and document approval/traceability.

Title: Prepare modelling inputs
Description: Prepare numeric and categorical modelling inputs using the approved feature logic.

Title: Create temporal train, validation and test split
Description: Create time-based train, validation and test datasets suitable for future-like evaluation.

Title: Validate class distribution and dataset consistency
Description: Check churn distribution, schema, transformations and data consistency across modelling datasets.

Title: Develop baseline and candidate models
Description: Train the baseline and agreed candidate models such as Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest and XGBoost/alternative.

Title: Perform hyperparameter tuning if required
Description: Tune selected model parameters when agreed and validate improvements against the untuned models.

Title: Track model experiments in MLflow
Description: Log model runs, parameters, metrics and artifacts in MLflow for comparison and reproducibility.

Title: Evaluate candidate models using agreed metrics
Description: Evaluate candidates using ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, precision, recall, F1, confusion matrix, lift and calibration where applicable.

Title: Compare model performance and business suitability
Description: Compare models consistently across technical performance, stability and business/operational considerations.

Title: Select and document final model
Description: Select the preferred churn model and document the rationale and key trade-offs.

Title: Implement global and account-level explainability
Description: Produce global feature importance and account-level explanations for churn-risk predictions.

Title: Generate churn drivers and risk bands
Description: Create interpretable churn/risk drivers and define/validate risk bands from model scores.

Title: Review model results and drivers with Business SME
Description: Review model performance, explainability outputs and risk bands with the Business SME and capture feedback/sign-off.

Title: Register and version approved model
Description: Register the selected model in the governed MLflow/Unity Catalog registry with traceable model versions.

Title: Configure Champion/Candidate promotion and metadata
Description: Define promotion/aliasing and capture the required model, experiment and training metadata.

Title: Validate promotion and rollback process
Description: Test model promotion and document/test how scoring can revert to a prior approved model version.

Title: Build batch-scoring pipeline and output schema
Description: Build the batch-scoring workflow and define the required account-level scoring output schema.

Title: Generate predictions, risk bands and model metadata
Description: Generate churn probability, predicted churn, risk bands, risk drivers, scoring date and model-version metadata.

Title: Validate and schedule scoring job
Description: Validate scoring outputs and configure the Databricks job/workflow according to the approved refresh schedule.

Title: Implement prediction and feature-drift monitoring
Description: Monitor prediction distributions and important model inputs for material changes over time.

Title: Implement performance monitoring and backtesting
Description: Backtest the model and calculate realised performance once actual churn outcomes become available.

Title: Define retraining criteria and monitoring actions
Description: Document retraining triggers, monitoring thresholds, review ownership and required actions.

Title: Publish ML output table or interface
Description: Publish approved account-level churn prediction outputs in the agreed Databricks table/view/interface.

Title: Enable Power BI and downstream consumption
Description: Provide the agreed output source/interface for Power BI and other approved downstream consumers.

Title: Validate downstream integration
Description: Validate output schema, account-level predictions, accessibility and downstream operational use.
